picks.title: Saturated Saturday: When God Doesn’t Do What You Think He Should — Pastor Jason Shepperd
picks.summary:
What happens to your faith when God doesn’t do what you think a good God should do?
The gospel doesn’t promise a life without pain. It gives us hope in the middle of it. In 2 Samuel 12, David faces unimaginable loss and has a decision to make: will his pain cause him to stop seeking God, or lead him into deeper trust and surrender?
Grace doesn’t disappear when pain enters our lives, and God’s character doesn’t change when our circumstances do.The gospel includes suffering, but it ends in resurrection. Because the tomb is empty, pain does not get the final word.
📌 Supplemental Resources:
• Jaso
picks.reason: A pastor reflects on faith and suffering through David's story in 2 Samuel 12.

picks.reason: A personal conversation on faith, grief, and suffering after tragic loss.

picks.title: I Asked 4 Divorced Christians What The Church Has Wrong
picks.summary: Divorce is one of the hardest things to talk about in church. We know how to celebrate marriage, but we don't always know how to sit with people when it ends. They were honest about their own choices and about the ways the church helped—or made an already painful season harder. picks.reason: Honest discussion on divorce, grief, and church responses from divorced Christians.

picks.title: EP: 468 The Church is Afraid of the Supernatural with Jon Moffitt
picks.summary:
Jon Moffitt is a Reformed pastor, and in his world, you do not talk about this. Demons, principalities, the divine council, the unseen war Paul describes in Ephesians. It is not that the Reformed church calls it heresy. It is that the Reformed church is so afraid of looking charismatic that it simply goes quiet. Jon lives in that silence for years, until he sits down to preach the Lord's Prayer and gets stuck on one line. Deliver us from the evil one. He realizes he has never heard a single sermon on it, and pulling that thread unravels everything he thought he was allowed to say.

picks.reason: A Reformed pastor confronts spiritual warfare and church silence on demons.

picks.title: Egyptian Gods Explained 🐍☀️ | The Gods, Myths, and Legends of Ancient Egypt | Boring History for Sleep
picks.summary: The gods of ancient Egypt were woven into almost every part of life, from the rising sun and the flooding Nile to kingship, protection, death, and the journey into the afterlife. But who were these powerful and mysterious deities?This documentary explores the fascinating world of Egyptian mythology, from Ra, Osiris, Isis, and Horus to Anubis, Set, Thoth, and many lesser-known gods and goddesses. Discover their stories, symbols, relationships, rivalries, and the myths that shaped how ancient Egyptians understood the world around them.Why were Egyptian gods often portrayed with animal features?
picks.reason: Covers Egyptian mythology and death beliefs, touching on meaning and afterlife.
